title: Toddler Days Out: Gentle, Fun and Under-5s Free Ideas
description: The best days out for toddlers and under-5s: farm parks, soft play, aquariums, Peppa Pig World, gentle rides and free museums, with nap-friendly planning tips.
h1: Days out for toddlers and under-5s
intro: Animals, water, buttons to press and space to run. These are Scout’s favourite days out for little ones, many with under-3s or under-5s free.

blocks.title: Scout’s toddler verdict
blocks.text: Go short, go early and plan around the nap. Many attractions let under-3s in free, so these are golden years for cheap days out.

sections.html: See the best days out with toddlers and where kids go free.

faqs.q: Do toddlers need tickets for attractions?
faqs.a: Many attractions let under-2s or under-3s in free, but some still ask you to reserve a free ticket. Check the attraction’s website.

keywords: things to do with a toddler
cardText: Farm parks, soft play, aquariums and gentle rides.
